data.name: Codex-Named Unit (equipment_adventurers_guide_ag_equip_arms_armor_lst_6)
data.description: This metal suit includes gauntlets, heavy leather boots, a visored helmet, and a thick layer of padding that is worn underneath the armor. Each suit of Gray Maiden plate must be individually fitted to its owner by a master armorsmith, although a captured suit can be resized to fit a new owner at a cost of 200 to 800 (2d4 x 100) gold pieces.
